text:
Ana Morales: Quick request — need a compact benchmark asset bundle for next week's webinar + launch posts. Deliverables: hero benchmark tile (latency vs cost narrative), two social micro-tiles, webinar slide template with data callout and CTA that routes to our inbound form. Brand + accessibility required. First drafts by Weds EOD.
Lina Chen: Got it. Quick Q: metrics to show — p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, and cost/token? Or swap throughput for req/s?
Mike Patel: Include p50 and p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost/token. Also a tiny sample table comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private unit economics. I'll drop numbers shortly.
Samir Desai: Messaging note — working headline: "Serving wins: lower cost, predictable latency". Need a conservative variant for APAC channels (legal).
Kate Rivera: Brand constraints: use Approved Blue #0A6CF0 for primary accents, follow logo clearspace in Brand Kit. Ensure AA contrast for body; aim for AAA on small text where possible. Avoid gradients that interfere with logo overlays. Provide SVGs for logos; flattened PNG for export.
Design-Bot: Figma template stub: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-mini-bundle 
Export guidance:
```
hero: 1200x630 PNG @2x, max 1.5MB
micro-tile: 1080x1080 PNG @2x
slide master: 1920x1080, left gutter 96px
format: PNG sRGB; include SVG logo/icons
alt text: one-line descriptive alt for each asset
```
Lina Chen: Two design clarifications: 1) hero — comparative bars or sparkline? 2) include optional micro-infographic for cache+batching effect?
Ana Morales: Use comparative bars for hero (scan-friendly). Add a micro 1:1 infographic tile that says "cache + batching = lower cost" with minimal copy.
Jordan Lee: CTA routing: slide CTA -> webinar form should tag leads with "bench_webinar_2026" and utm_campaign=bench_launch. I'll update routing doc once assets are uploaded.
Mike Patel: Sample numbers for labels: Hosted: p95=320ms, tokens/sec=150, cost/token=$0.0009. Dedicated: p95=180ms, tokens/sec=420, cost/token=$0.0006. Private: p95=210ms, tokens/sec=380, cost/token=$0.0005. Use Hosted as baseline.
Lina Chen: Great — I'll mock comparative bars with p95 callouts and a tiny cost delta badge. Samir: will include conservative-language layer.
Samir Desai: Also need a 1-line metadata strip on hero (model, seq len, test harness link). Legal asks that the test harness link be behind a disclosure on the page but visible on the slide as "see notes".
Kate Rivera: Accessibility reminder — check contrast for the green cost-delta badge and ensure icon stroke weights meet accessibility specs. Provide both color and high-contrast mono SVGs.
Lina Chen: Timeline: posting Figma frames by Tues EOB, final exports by Thurs noon. Who owns QA?
Ana Morales: Marketing will QA messaging; design to run visual QC (contrast, bleed). Jordan will update routing doc.
Design-Bot: PRD checklist created: [x] Figma frames, [ ] alt text doc, [ ] export assets, [ ] routing update. PRD link: https://internal.redwood/ops/bench-asset-prd
Jordan Lee: I'll own routing update — ping me with final assets and a CSV mapping CTAs -> tags.
Mike Patel: For the webinar slide add a fixed-width code snippet area (300x150px) for "sample query latency" code. Lina — please reserve that region and include a dark-mode slide variant.
Lina Chen: Will include the code area and dark-mode master. Also adding Figma layers: "conservative_copy" and "motion_opt" (Lottie-friendly frame).
Ana Morales: Please post Figma links and quick screenshots in this thread for review. Call out blockers asap. :art: :rocket:
Lina Chen: First frames posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/frame-1 — feedback welcome.
Mike Patel: Left two micro-copy comments on the frame.
Kate Rivera: Visual pass done — swapped two colors and adjusted logo usage. Comments on Figma.
Samir Desai: Conservative copy uploaded to the doc for localization. Need final by Thurs AM for translations.
Design-Bot: Uploaded stub assets to /s3/bench/webinar/stubs/1812345999.zip (marketing-team perms).
Ana Morales: Thanks team — marking as in-progress. Final QA Thurs.
